question: Four friends P, Q, R and S run around a circular track of length 400 m starting at the same point at the same time at speeds of 4, 8, 16 and 20 m/s, respectively. If all of them are moving in the same direction, after how much time would they meet for the first time?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 400 m

Speed of P = 4 m/sec

Speed of Q = 8 m/sec

Speed of R = 16 m/sec

Speed of S = 20 m/sec

**Concept used:**

Time taken to meet for the first time = LCM of time taken by the runners individually

Where,

L = distance

p, q, r, and s are the speeds of the runner P, Q, R, and S respectively.
